The improvement of Lincoln Highway should make travel to and from this shopping center safer and easier, although the improvement, per se, should not attract a significantly greater number of shoppers to the area.
The improvement of Lincoln Highway is being coordinated with the Illinois Central Gulf Railroad Commuter park-and-ride facility improvement at the intersection of Lincoln Highway and Olympian Way in Olympia Fields. The park-and-ride facility will also have a bus turn around which will accommodate up to eight busses at a time under a canopy which will protect waiting passengers from inclement weather conditions. The improvement of Lincoln Highway and the intersection improvement at Lincoln Highway and Olympian Way are vital to the bus lines serving this commuter station. Present traffic conditions in this area hinder the ingress and egress of busses to and from the station and the lack of turning lanes and signalization at the intersection of Olympian Way and Lincoln Highway impedes the flow of traffic out of the parking area and on Lincoln Highway. This transportation facility, along with the reconstructed highway, will enhance the total transportation system for the area and heighten the residential appeal of the area for those workers who commute to the central business district of Chicago, as well as the workers who are employed in industrial and commercial enterprises located along the Illinois Central Gulf commuter line.
Since the improvement is the reconstruction of an existing facility the action should not generate any perceptual change in the economic or residential make up of the communities through which Lincoln Highway passes.
Lincoln Highway is shown as an arterial in Chicago Area Transportation Study's 1995 Transportation System Plan, and is presently performing as an arterial. Therefore, the improvement of this facility will not have a significant affect on property values.
The total number of acres of land to be taken is approximately 16.2 acres. It is anticipated that the amount of land to be taken for this improvement will not affect the tax base.
